summary_1line: Walton rescues the exhausted Victor Frankenstein pursuing a mysterious giant across the Arctic ice; Victor agrees to tell the tragic story of his downfall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Through a clearing fog on the endless Arctic ice, sailors watch a gigantic figure driving a dog sledge across the frozen plain.
A half-dead man lies in a shattered sledge on a drifting ice floe as sailors haul him toward the ship while the Arctic sea churns around them.
Inside the ship’s cabin, the gaunt stranger weeps with his hands over his eyes as Walton speaks passionately about sacrificing everything for knowledge.
